posts.title: [JavaFX]实现第一个JavaFx应用程序
posts.text: 实现步骤 Create and set up the window. Add the ubiquitous “Hello World” label. Display the window. More info: Writing-test 1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132import javax.swing.*; public class HelloWorldSwing { /** * Create the GUI and show it. For thread safety, * this method should be invoked from the * event-dispatching thread. */ private static void createAndShowGUI() { //Create and set up the window. JFrame frame = new JFrame("HelloWorldSwing"); frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); //Add the ubiquitous "Hello World" label. JLabel label = new JLabel("Hello World"); frame.getContentPane().add(label); //Display the window. frame.pack(); frame.setVisible(true); } public static void main(String[] args) { //Schedule a job for the event-dispatching thread: //creating and showing this application's GUI. javax.swing.SwingUtilities.invokeLater(new Runnable() { public void run() { createAndShowGUI(); } }); }}
